# Kripa Revival Centre

> Kripa Revival Centre is a licensed residential de-addiction and rehabilitation centre in Hebbal, Bengaluru. For 18 years (since 2008), it has supported individuals and families through medical care, counselling, family involvement, community living and a structured 12-Step programme.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/): Overview, trust information and contact options.
- [About](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/about/): Purpose, founder, legacy, credentials and licences.
- [Programme](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/programme/): Four-month residential recovery programme.
- [Care](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/care/): Medical, therapeutic and family-support services.
- [Our place](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/our-place/): Residential environment, facilities and daily rhythm.
- [Families](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/families/): Guidance for families considering residential treatment.
- [Licenses & Certificates](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/licenses/): Verifiable licences, registrations, certificates and awards.
- [Gallery](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/gallery/): Photographs of the centre - rooms, common areas, rooftop garden, and recognition visits.
- [Q&A](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/qa/): Plain answers to common family questions (formerly the blog).
- [Alcohol addiction](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/alcohol-addiction/): Signs, and how treatment works.
- [Drug addiction](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/drug-addiction/): Signs, and how treatment works.
- [Contact](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/contact/): Telephone, WhatsApp, email, address and map.
- [Privacy policy](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/privacy/): How enquiries and personal information are handled.
- [Terms of use](https://kriparevivalcentre.org/terms/): Conditions for using the website and its information.

## What we do

- Residential de-addiction and rehabilitation care for adults.
- Medical assessment, detoxification support and withdrawal management.
- Individual counselling, group therapy and 12-Step facilitation.
- Relapse-prevention planning, family education and aftercare preparation.
- Confidential first conversations for individuals and families seeking guidance.

## What we do not do

- This website does not diagnose a condition or replace a clinical assessment.
- Website content is not medical advice or an emergency service.
- Admission, treatment duration, availability and outcomes are not guaranteed by website content.
- Testimonials describe individual experiences and do not promise the same result for another person.
- Detailed medical records should not be sent through ordinary email or WhatsApp unless the team requests them and explains the appropriate method.

## Enquiries

- The site has a built-in enquiry chat (bottom-right on every page) that asks what the visitor needs help with, collects their name and phone number, and emails the details to info@kriparevivalcentre.org.
